source: The app's default scene (probe + 852 nm tweezer, defaultScene() in src/types.ts) as the app sends it, mean-only. Exact references: R1's dense N = 1 lattice solve of the model-identical probeTweezer_new case (32 states): p(T) at T = 1e5 and 1e6 us (its chosen method; both solvers agree with it to 7e-7) and the steady state. Release v2026.10.28.1 returned the steady state for T = 1e5 (off by 7.8e-3, bound 7e-13): the frame's classes at 5.6e-7 and 8.7e-7 /us were outside its space.
